text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, that couple from the other day 
got in touch with me. Said they had a 
great, safe trip in Japan~.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, were you looking for Furlong Tower? 
Whew, what a relief...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, it totally freaked me out back then. 
Being approached by someone speaking a 
language so rare that translation apps 
couldn't even handle it...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yet the two of you still managed to 
communicate and guide the way so 
brilliantly... My, my, simply marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's because the other person tried so 
hard to get their message across to us. 
Right, Buena-san?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's true! I could kind of sense how 
troubled you were feeling. But that's all 
it was for me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-san really seemed to understand every 
word... it was truly amazing!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No... it was just a hunch for me too. The 
look on your face, the gestures of your 
hands... I just got a soft, general 
impression from the whole picture.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Tenshi-s, bravo, bravo! 
Though it feels a bit weird for me to say 
that when I couldn't do anything at all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! Tran-san, you didn't give 
up until the very end and gave it your 
all, didn't you...?!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You were trying to deduce their 
message from what you already knew... 
striving to understand their feelings with 
utmost accuracy.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain they could sense how sincerely 
you tried to handle everything until the 
very end. If we're angels, then... you are 
one too.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there...? ...Are we about to become 
the Three Angels~?
